spanish: Seis días lo recogerán, y en el día el séptimo sábado; no será en él.
grammarChanges: Translated the untranslated Hebrew noun 'shabat' (H7676) as 'sábado' to repair the auditor fail.
Left the semicolon separating 'sábado' from 'no será' unchanged; which noun 'no será' predicates (sábado or the implicit manna) is a clause-role question, not a punctuation repair.
readerNote: hold: clause role — whether 'sábado' or the implicit manna is the subject that 'no será' predicates over was left unresolved.
